apps.name: 只要考得好，妈妈可以满足我一个不花钱的要求
apps.description:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1.0,maximum-scale=1.0,user-scalable=no,viewport-fit=cover">
<title>这个家</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Ma+Shan+Zheng&family=Long+Cang&family=Noto+Serif+SC:wght@400;600;900&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
:root{
--c-wall:#3d2419;
--c-wall-deep:#2a1810;
--c-light:#f4d8a8;
--c-light-soft:#f9e8c8;
--c-mom:#c2185b;
--c-mom-soft:#e91e63;
--c-paper:#f5e6c8;
--c-paper-deep:#e8d4a8;
--c-ink:#3d2419;
--c-ink-soft:#5a3a28;
--c-window:#ffd98a;
--ff-hand:'Ma Shan Zheng','Long Cang',cursive;
--ff-hand2:'Long Cang',cursive;
--ff-body:'Noto Serif SC',serif;
--shadow-warm:0 4px 20px rgba(244,216,168,.3);
--shadow-deep:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.4);
}
html,body{
width:100%;
overflow-x:hidden;
font-family:var(--ff-body);
color:var(--c-ink);
font-size:16px;
line-height:1.7;
-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
}
body{
min-height:100vh;
min-height:100dvh;
position:relative;
background-image:url('https://img.cdn1.vip/i/69f4741756ae5_1777628183.webp');
background-repeat:repeat;
background-size:auto;
background-attachment:fixed;
background-color:#f5e6c8;
}
body::before{
content:'';position:fixed;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:1;
background:rgba(255,248,232,.4);
}
body::after{
content:'';position:fixed;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:2;
background:radial-gradient(ellipse at center,transparent 50%,rgba(194,24,91,.08) 100%);
}
@media (min-width:1024px){body{cursor:url("data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='32' height='32' viewBox='0 0 32 32'><defs><radialGradient id='g' cx='50%25' cy='40%25'><stop offset='0%25' stop-color='%23ffd98a' stop-opacity='1'/><stop offset='100%25' stop-color='%23ffd98a' stop-opacity='0'/></radialGradient></defs><circle cx='16' cy='14' r='14' fill='url(%23g)' opacity='.6'/><path d='M12 8 L20 8 L18 14 L14 14 Z' fill='%23c2185b'/><rect x='15' y='14' width='2' height='3' fill='%233d2419'/></svg>") 16 16,auto}}
.intro{
position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:9999;
background:#000;
display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
flex-direction:column;
transition:opacity 1.2s ease,visibility 1.2s ease;
padding:24px;
}
.intro.fade-out{opacity:0;visibility:hidden;pointer-events:none}
.intro-skip{
position:absolute;top:max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-top));right:16px;
min-width:64px;min-height:44px;padding:8px 16px;
background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2);
color:rgba(255,255,255,.7);font-family:var(--ff-body);font-size:14px;
border-radius:22px;cursor:pointer;
transition:all .3s;letter-spacing:1px;
}
.intro-skip:active,.intro-skip:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.15);color:#fff}
.intro-line{
font-family:var(--ff-body);font-size:18px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.85);
text-align:center;letter-spacing:3px;line-height:2;
opacity:0;
}
.intro-line.show{animation:lineFade 2s ease forwards}
.intro-quote{
font-family:var(--ff-hand);font-size:24px;color:var(--c-mom-soft);
text-align:center;letter-spacing:2px;line-height:1.8;
opacity:0;max-width:520px;
text-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(194,24,91,.5);
}
.intro-quote.show{animation:quoteFade 2.5s ease forwards}
.intro-quote::before,.intro-quote::after{
content:'"';font-size:32px;color:var(--c-mom-soft);opacity:.6;
}
@keyframes lineFade{0%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(10px)}30%{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}80%{opacity:1}100%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-10px)}}
@keyframes quoteFade{0%{opacity:0;transform:scale(.95)}30%{opacity:1;transform:scale(1)}85%{opacity:1}100%{opacity:0}}
.intro-title{
position:absolute;top:38%;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);
font-family:var(--ff-hand);font-size:36px;color:var(--c-window);
letter-spacing:6px;opacity:0;
text-shadow:0 0 30px rgba(255,217,138,.6);
white-space:nowrap;
}
.intro-title.show{animation:titleShine 2s ease forwards}
@keyframes titleShine{0%{opacity:0;letter-spacing:20px}100%{opacity:1;letter-spacing:6px}}
.intro-tip{
position:absolute;bottom:14%;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);
font-family:var(--ff-body);font-size:13px;color:rgba(244,216,168,.7);
letter-spacing:3px;opacity:0;
}
.intro-tip.show{animation:tipBlink 1.5s ease infinite 1s}
@keyframes tipBlink{0%,100%{opacity:.4}50%{opacity:.9}}
.app{
position:relative;z-index:10;
min-height:100vh;min-height:100dvh;
display:flex;flex-direction:column;
opacity:0;transition:opacity 1s ease;
padding-top:max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-top));
padding-bottom:max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
}
.app.show{opacity:1}
.app-header{
flex:0 0 auto;
text-align:center;padding:12px 16px 8px;
position:relative;
}
.app-header h1{
font-family:var(--ff-hand);font-size:24px;color:var(--c-mom);
letter-spacing:5px;font-weight:normal;
text-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(255,255,255,.6);
}
.app-header .sub{
font-family:var(--ff-body);font-size:12px;color:var(--c-ink-soft);
letter-spacing:2px;margin-top:2px;opacity:.7;
}
.house-view{
flex:0 0 auto;
padding:12px 16px;
position:relative;
display:flex;justify-content:center;
}
.house{
width:100%;max-width:520px;
position:relative;
filter:drop-shadow(0 12px 32px rgba(194,24,91,.25));
}
.house-roof{
height:24px;
background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--c-mom) 0%,#9a1248 100%);
clip-path:polygon(8% 100%,50% 0,92% 100%);
margin:0 auto;width:90%;
position:relative;z-index:2;
}
.house-grid{
display:grid;
grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr;
gap:6px;
background:var(--c-wall);
padding:8px;
border-radius:8px;
border:3px solid var(--c-wall-deep);
box-shadow:inset 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.4),0 8px 24px rgba(61,36,25,.3);
}
.room{
position:relative;
aspect-ratio:1/1.1;
background:linear-gradient(160deg,#3a2418 0%,#2a1810 100%);
border-radius:5px;
overflow:hidden;
cursor:pointer;
transition:all .4s ease;
display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
padding:6px;
border:1px solid rgba(244,216,168,.15);
}
.room::before{
content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;
background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 35%,rgba(255,217,138,.3) 0%,transparent 70%);
opacity:.5;transition:opacity .4s;
}
.room:active::before,.room:hover::before{opacity:1}
.room:active,.room:hover{
border-color:rgba(255,217,138,.6);
transform:scale(1.04);
z-index:5;
box-shadow:0 0 28px rgba(255,217,138,.4);
}
.room-icon{
width:55%;height:48%;
display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
position:relative;z-index:2;
opacity:.9;
transition:transform .4s,opacity .4s;
margin-bottom:4px;
}
.room:active .room-icon,.room:hover .room-icon{opacity:1;transform:translateY(-2px)}
.room-icon svg{width:100%;height:100%}
.room-name{
font-family:var(--ff-hand);font-size:16px;
color:var(--c-light-soft);
letter-spacing:1.5px;
text-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(0,0,0,.8);
position:relative;z-index:2;
margin-top:2px;
}
.room-tag{
font-family:var(--ff-body);font-size:10px;
color:rgba(244,216,168,.7);
letter-spacing:.5px;
position:relative;z-index:2;
margin-top:2px;
text-align:center;
line-height:1.3;
}
.room.mom-room::before{background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 35%,rgba(233,30,99,.4) 0%,rgba(255,217,138,.2) 50%,transparent 80%)}
.room.mom-room .room-name{color:#ffc4d8;text-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(194,24,91,.6)}
.room-detail{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:1}
.tv-glow{position:absolute;bottom:25%;left:25%;width:50%;height:30%;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#5a8fbf,#3a6f9f);border-radius:3px;animation:tvFlicker 4s ease-in-out infinite;opacity:.5}
@keyframes tvFlicker{0%,100%{opacity:.4;background:#5a8fbf}25%{opacity:.7;background:#7aafd5}50%{opacity:.5;background:#4a7faf}75%{opacity:.8;background:#8abff5}}
.curtain{position:absolute;top:5%;right:8%;width:30%;height:55%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(194,24,91,.4) 0%,rgba(194,24,91,.2) 50%,rgba(194,24,91,.4) 100%);transform-origin:top center;animation:curtainSway 5s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes curtainSway{0%,100%{transform:skewX(0deg)}50%{transform:skewX(3deg)}}
.lamp-glow{position:absolute;bottom:25%;right:18%;width:35%;height:35%;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,217,138,.7) 0%,transparent 70%);animation:lampFlicker 3s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes lampFlicker{0%,100%{opacity:.7}50%{opacity:1}}
.guide{
flex:1 1 auto;
padding:24px 24px 16px;
display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;
text-align:center;
position:relative;
}
.guide-text{
font-family:var(--ff-hand);font-size:20px;
color:var(--c-ink);
line-height:2;letter-spacing:2px;
margin-bottom:18px;
opacity:.85;
text-shadow:0 1px 4px rgba(255,255,255,.5);
}
.guide-text .accent{color:var(--c-mom)}
.guide-arrow{
font-family:var(--ff-body);font-size:13px;
color:var(--c-mom);
letter-spacing:3px;
animation:arrowBlink 2s ease-in-out infinite;
opacity:.8;
}
@keyframes arrowBlink{0%,100%{opacity:.4;transform:translateY(0)}50%{opacity:.9;transform:translateY(2px)}}
.room-page{
position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:100;
background-image:url('https://img.cdn1.vip/i/69f4741756ae5_1777628183.webp');
background-repeat:repeat;
background-color:#f5e6c8;
display:flex;flex-direction:column;
transform:translateY(100%);
transition:transform .5s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1);
visibility:hidden;
padding-top:max(0px,env(safe-area-inset-top));
padding-bottom:max(0px,env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
}
.room-page::after{
content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;
background:rgba(255,248,232,.4);
}
.room-page.show{transform:translateY(0);visibility:visible}
.page-header{
flex:0 0 auto;
display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;
padding:14px 16px;
background:rgba(255,248,232,.92);
backdrop-filter:blur(12px) saturate(1.2);
-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(12px) saturate(1.2);
border-bottom:1px solid rgba(194,24,91,.2);
position:sticky;top:0;z-index:10;
}
.btn-back{
min-width:44px;min-height:44px;
display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
background:rgba(194,24,91,.08);border:1px solid rgba(194,24,91,.25);
border-radius:22px;padding:0 16px;
color:var(--c-mom);font-family:var(--ff-body);font-size:14px;
cursor:pointer;transition:all .3s;letter-spacing:1px;
gap:4px;font-weight:600;
}
.btn-back:active,.btn-back:hover{background:rgba(194,24,91,.18)}
.page-title{
font-family:var(--ff-hand);font-size:20px;
color:var(--c-mom);letter-spacing:3px;
flex:1;text-align:center;
}
.page-title-icon{
width:36px;height:36px;
display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
opacity:.85;
}
.page-title-icon svg{width:24px;height:24px}
.page-content{
flex:1 1 auto;
overflow-y:auto;
padding:24px 18px 100px;
-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;
position:relative;z-index:1;
}
.card{
background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fffaf0 0%,var(--c-paper) 100%);
color:var(--c-ink);
border-radius:8px;
padding:18px 20px;
margin-bottom:18px;
position:relative;
box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(194,24,91,.15),inset 0 0 60px rgba(244,216,168,.2);
font-family:var(--ff-body);
border:1px solid rgba(194,24,91,.12);
}
.card::before{
content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;border-radius:8px;
background-image:
radial-gradient(circle at 20% 30%,rgba(139,90,50,.04) 0%,transparent 40%),
radial-gradient(circle at 80% 70%,rgba(139,90,50,.04) 0%,transparent 40%);
}
.card-title{
font-family:var(--ff-hand);font-size:22px;color:var(--c-mom);
margin-bottom:12px;letter-spacing:2px;
border-bottom:1px dashed rgba(194,24,91,.3);
padding-bottom:8px;
display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;
}
.card-title-icon{font-size:20px}
.card p{
font-size:15px;line-height:1.9;color:var(--c-ink-soft);
margin-bottom:10px;
text-indent:2em;
}
.card p:last-child{margin-bottom:0}
.card .highlight{color:var(--c-mom);font-weight:600}
.card .quote{
font-family:var(--ff-hand);font-size:17px;color:var(--c-mom);
text-indent:0;text-align:center;
padding:8px 12px;margin:8px 0;
border-left:3px solid var(--c-mom);
background:rgba(194,24,91,.06);
letter-spacing:1px;
}
.mom-portrait{
text-align:center;
padding:32px 0 28px;
position:relative;
border-bottom:1px dashed rgba(194,24,91,.3);
margin-bottom:20px;
}
.mom-portrait::before{
content:'·   ·   ·';
display:block;
color:var(--c-mom);
font-size:14px;
letter-spacing:6px;
margin-bottom:14px;
opacity:.5;
}
.mom-portrait::after{
content:'·   ·   ·';
display:block;
color:var(--c-mom);
font-size:14px;
letter-spacing:6px;
margin-top:14px;
opacity:.5;
}
.mom-name{
font-family:var(--ff-hand);font-size:28px;color:var(--c-mom);
letter-spacing:6px;text-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(255,255,255,.6);
}
.mom-name-sub{
font-family:var(--ff-body);font-size:13px;color:var(--c-ink-soft);
letter-spacing:5px;margin-top:6px;opacity:.8;
}
.diary{
background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fffaf0 0%,var(--c-paper) 100%);
color:var(--c-ink);
border-radius:6px;
margin-bottom:14px;
position:relative;
box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(194,24,91,.12);
overflow:hidden;
transition:transform .3s ease;
border:1px solid rgba(194,24,91,.12);
}
.diary::before{
content:'';position:absolute;left:8px;top:0;bottom:0;width:1px;
background:repeating-linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(194,24,91,.3) 0,rgba(194,24,91,.3) 4px,transparent 4px,transparent 8px);
}
.diary:hover{transform:translateY(-2px)}
.diary-head{
display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;
padding:14px 16px 14px 24px;
cursor:pointer;
user-select:none;
position:relative;
}
.diary-emoji{font-size:22px;flex-shrink:0}
.diary-title{
flex:1;
font-family:var(--ff-hand);font-size:18px;color:var(--c-mom);
letter-spacing:2px;
}
.diary-toggle{
width:24px;height:24px;
display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
color:var(--c-mom);font-size:18px;
transition:transform .3s;
}
.diary.open .diary-toggle{transform:rotate(180deg)}
.diary-body{
max-height:0;overflow:hidden;
transition:max-height .5s ease;
}
.diary.open .diary-body{max-height:1500px}
.diary-content{
padding:0 18px 18px 24px;
border-top:1px dashed rgba(194,24,91,.2);
padding-top:12px;
}
.diary-content p{
font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.95;color:var(--c-ink-soft);
margin-bottom:8px;text-indent:2em;
}
.diary-content .label{
display:inline-block;
font-family:var(--ff-hand);font-size:15px;color:var(--c-mom);
margin-right:6px;font-weight:bold;
}
.diary-content ul{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:6px 0}
.diary-content li{
font-size:14px;line-height:1.85;color:var(--c-ink-soft);
padding:3px 0 3px 18px;position:relative;
}
.diary-content li::before{
content:'·';position:absolute;left:6px;top:0;
color:var(--c-mom);font-weight:bold;font-size:18px;
}
.form-paper{
background:
repeating-linear-gradient(180deg,transparent 0,transparent 28px,rgba(194,24,91,.08) 28px,rgba(194,24,91,.08) 29px),
linear-gradient(180deg,#fffaf0 0%,var(--c-paper) 100%);
color:var(--c-ink);
border-radius:8px;
padding:24px 20px;
margin-bottom:18px;
box-shadow:0 6px 20px rgba(194,24,91,.15);
position:relative;
border:1px solid rgba(194,24,91,.12);
}
.form-paper::before{
content:'';position:absolute;left:36px;top:0;bottom:0;width:1px;
background:rgba(194,24,91,.25);
}
.form-paper-title{
font-family:var(--ff-hand);font-size:24px;color:var(--c-mom);
text-align:center;letter-spacing:4px;margin-bottom:8px;
}
.form-paper-sub{
font-family:var(--ff-body);font-size:12px;color:var(--c-ink-soft);
text-align:center;letter-spacing:2px;opacity:.7;margin-bottom:24px;
border-bottom:1px dashed rgba(194,24,91,.3);padding-bottom:12px;
}
.field{margin-bottom:20px;position:relative}
.field-label{
display:block;
font-family:var(--ff-hand);font-size:16px;color:var(--c-mom);
margin-bottom:8px;letter-spacing:1px;
}
.field-label .num{
display:inline-block;width:22px;height:22px;
background:var(--c-mom);color:#fff;border-radius:50%;
text-align:center;line-height:22px;font-size:13px;
margin-right:6px;font-family:var(--ff-body);
}
.field-label .opt{
font-size:12px;color:var(--c-ink-soft);
font-family:var(--ff-body);font-weight:normal;
margin-left:6px;opacity:.7;
}
.field input[type="text"],.field input[type="number"],.field textarea{
width:100%;
min-height:48px;
padding:12px 14px;
font-family:var(--ff-body);font-size:16px;
color:var(--c-ink);
background:rgba(255,255,255,.5);
border:1px solid rgba(194,24,91,.25);
border-radius:6px;
transition:all .3s;
-webkit-appearance:none;
}
.field textarea{
min-height:80px;
resize:vertical;
line-height:1.7;
}
.field input:focus,.field textarea:focus{
outline:none;
border-color:var(--c-mom);
background:#fff;
box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(194,24,91,.15);
}
.field input::placeholder,.field textarea::placeholder{
color:rgba(93,58,40,.4);
font-style:italic;
}
.radio-group{
display:grid;
grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(80px,1fr));
gap:8px;
}
.radio-btn{position:relative}
.radio-btn input{position:absolute;opacity:0;pointer-events:none}
.radio-btn label{
display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
min-height:48px;padding:8px 14px;
background:rgba(255,255,255,.5);
border:1.5px solid rgba(194,24,91,.25);
border-radius:6px;
font-family:var(--ff-body);font-size:15px;color:var(--c-ink);
cursor:pointer;transition:all .25s;
text-align:center;
}
.radio-btn input:checked+label{
background:var(--c-mom);color:#fff;
border-color:var(--c-mom);
box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(194,24,91,.35);
transform:translateY(-1px);
}
.radio-btn label:active{transform:scale(.97)}
.custom-call{margin-top:8px;display:none}
.custom-call.show{display:block;animation:fieldFade .3s ease}
@keyframes fieldFade{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-4px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
.preview-wrap{margin-top:24px}
.preview-label{
font-family:var(--ff-hand);font-size:18px;color:var(--c-mom);
letter-spacing:2px;margin-bottom:10px;
display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;
}
.preview-box{
background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fff8e8 0%,#f5e6c8 100%);
border:1px solid rgba(194,24,91,.2);
border-radius:6px;
padding:18px 20px;
font-family:var(--ff-body);font-size:14.5px;
line-height:1.95;color:var(--c-ink);
min-height:120px;
white-space:pre-wrap;
word-wrap:break-word;
position:relative;
box-shadow:inset 0 0 20px rgba(244,216,168,.4),0 4px 12px rgba(194,24,91,.1);
}
.preview-box::before{
content:'';position:absolute;top:-6px;left:30px;width:60px;height:14px;
background:rgba(194,24,91,.4);
transform:rotate(-3deg);
border-radius:2px;
opacity:.6;
}
.preview-empty{color:rgba(93,58,40,.4);font-style:italic}
.btn-copy{
margin-top:16px;width:100%;
min-height:54px;
background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--c-mom-soft) 0%,var(--c-mom) 100%);
color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:8px;
